answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 266 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the wander challenge, the signal audit can replay the willow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 990 identities would post 3867 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
